title: Tool protocol stdin v1 and v2

cases.title: Protocol v1 frames are still accepted
cases.when: A v1 artifact receives LocalToolInput and returns LocalToolOutput
then: The request binding and output schema are verified; the call succeeds

cases.title: A v1 output for another request is rejected
cases.when: The v1 output carries a different requestId

cases.title: The v2 ToolInput frame carries the required fields
cases.when: A v2 runtime receives ToolInput with and without each optional field
then: Required fields present; secretHandles are handles, never values; traceparent matches the pattern

cases.title: Each v2 output frame kind is parsed
cases.when: A tool emits PROGRESS, LOG, INPUT_REQUEST and RESULT frames
then: Each is accepted; resultType is complete, input_required or task

cases.title: Malformed frames end the invocation safely
cases.when: Frames with unknown kind, extra properties, fraction 1.5, log message over 8192 and two RESULT frames
then: The invocation fails with a fixed error; the host is unaffected

cases.title: Input and output ceilings
cases.when: Inputs of 1 MiB, 1 MiB + 1, 257 argument properties, and outputs of 4 MiB + 1
then: Within limits succeed; others are refused

cases.title: Negotiated limits never exceed a ceiling
cases.when: A tool asks for more than its pool, and a pool for more than the platform
then: Effective limit is the lowest layer

cases.title: The sync deadline is the lower of 60 s and the Gateway timeout
cases.when: A sync tool runs 31 s with a 30 s Gateway request timeout

cases.title: There is no fallback to a weaker tier
cases.when: A tool requires a tier the host does not offer
